# Test fixtures

- `htmx.min.js`: htmx 2.0.4, the unmodified minified release from
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.4/dist/htmx.min.js` (https://htmx.org). The release file carries no
  license header; its terms are in `htmx.LICENSE` (copied from the same package: Zero-Clause BSD). Served by the
  live Safari test's fixture server so the test needs no network.
